# Upstream licenses

*Generated by `tools/gen_docs.py` — verbatim copies from each source repository.*

`SKILL.md` text, only metadata — including each skill's name and description as
written upstream — so each upstream license is copied here for attribution.

## What is taken from upstream

Only each skill's `name` and `description`, quoted unmodified, and its list of
bundled file paths. Everything else is derived by `tools/build.py`: tags, a
quality score, size statistics and duplicate clustering. No upstream file is
copied or modified.
